$comment: OpenHands automation: run the Weather Channel structure watchdog every 24 hours. On CRITICAL_CHANGE_DETECTED the agent reads the report written to logs/, proposes updated selectors for config/selectors.json, and (optionally) opens a PR.
name: weather-channel-structure-watchdog

schedule.note: Runs once every 24 hours, at 06:00 UTC.

steps.name: report-ok
steps.note: Structure unchanged. logs/structure-check-history.jsonl records the run.

steps.name: repair-selectors
steps.prompt: A CRITICAL_CHANGE_DETECTED report was just written under logs/. Read the newest logs/critical-change-*.log, which contains the broken selector names, the selector registry in effect, and a full HTML snapshot. Propose corrected CSS selectors for the broken entries only, keep the config/selectors.json schema, and open a pull request titled 'fix: update weather.com selectors' with the change and a short explanation.

steps.name: report-error
steps.note: The watchdog could not reach weather.com (network outage, rate limiting, or config error). Retry next cycle; no selector change is implied.
